scripts.dev: bun run fmt && bun run typecheck && bun scripts/js.ts --dev
scripts.bootstrap: [ -x vcpkg/vcpkg ] || { [ -d vcpkg/.git ] || git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg.git vcpkg; ./vcpkg/bootstrap-vcpkg.sh -disableMetrics; }
scripts.fmt: biome format --write examples/js tests packages types && bun run fmt:cpp
scripts.fmt:check: biome format examples/js tests packages types
scripts.lint: biome lint examples/js tests packages types
scripts.fix: biome check --write examples/js tests packages types && bun run fmt:cpp
scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run fmt:cpp:check && bun run typecheck && bun run lint
scripts.ci: bun run check && bun run test
